items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, that's, that's a book by uh, Charters.

ctx.x: Yeah, we used to have uh, uh, Lucha used to play with us, with Thomas sometimes. Uh huh. Used to have Lucha playing with us. Uh huh.
Uh huh. You saw all this book, huh? Yeah, that's, that's a book by uh, Charters.

Cause they got some of the band pictures in this book, you know. Oh yeah. Doesn't have your picture though, does it? Uh huh. There's some of them, yeah. Is your picture in there? Huh? He's got your picture? No, my picture's nothing in there.
